summary_en: Cosel executed a block trade buyback of 1.6 million shares at ¥1,223 per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 13, 2026, representing 3.89% of shares outstanding. The total acquisition was capped at ¥1.96 billion.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Trading System (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Cosel's board approved the execution of a treasury share buyback via an off-hours block trade on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company executed the transaction on November 13, 2026, acquiring up to 1.6 million shares of its common stock at ¥1,223 per share, capped at ¥1.96 billion in aggregate. This acquisition represented 3.89% of shares outstanding (calculated as 1,600,000 ÷ 41,147,602, the number of shares excluding treasury shares as of October 20, 2026).

The buyback was conducted through ToSTNeT-3, an off-hours trading system, with the purchase order placed for the specific trading time window on November 13 at 8:45 a.m. The company stated that no changes to the planned share quantity were made, though noted that market conditions could result in partial or no execution of the repurchase.

Cosel cited two rationales for the buyback: enhancing capital efficiency to improve shareholder value, and maintaining flexibility to respond to changes in the operating environment through agile capital allocation policies.
